title: Uploading an employee photo returns 404
description:
## Description
On the employee card, choosing a new profile photo fails with a 404 error and the old photo stays.

## Implementation plan
**Technical details:** the upload form posts to `/api/employees/:id/photo`, but the route is registered as `/api/employee/:id/photo` in `server/routes/employees.js`.

title: Seed script creates duplicate demo users
description:
## Description
Running the seed twice creates every demo user again instead of skipping existing ones.
